name: Abyssal Sire

mechanics.name: Tentacle Guard
mechanics.description: Tentacles ring the throne, shielding the respiratory systems and lashing anyone who comes close.
mechanics.counterplay: Stun the Sire to drop them for 30 seconds. Shadow Barrage always stuns; 75 ranged or magic damage also works.

mechanics.name: Respiratory Systems
mechanics.description: Four respiratory systems sit in the corners of the room. The Sire stays on its throne until all four are destroyed.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill all four while the Sire is stunned. Demonbane weapons one-shot them.

mechanics.name: Miasma Pools
mechanics.description: The Sire drops a pool of miasma underneath you that deals rapid damage across a 3x3 area.
mechanics.counterplay: Step two tiles clear. Poison protection does nothing against it.

mechanics.name: Spawn Summon
mechanics.description: The Sire launches spawns from its mouth. They swarm you and chip away while you fight.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Missiles and out-damage them, or clear them fast.

mechanics.name: Scions
mechanics.description: Spawns left alone for about fifteen seconds mature into scions, which hit considerably harder.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill spawns before they grow up, or keep Protect from Missiles running.

mechanics.name: Melee Combo
mechanics.description: Off its throne the Sire swipes with an arm, flicks one tendril, or flicks both at once for heavy damage.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Melee. The double tendril flick still hurts through it.

mechanics.name: Safespot Dislodge
mechanics.description: Attack from too far away and the Sire hauls you back beside it, then discharges energy into you.
mechanics.counterplay: Stay in melee range. Safespotting only earns you a bigger hit.

mechanics.name: Minion Surge
mechanics.description: Anchored in the arena centre for its final stand, the Sire floods the room with spawns.
mechanics.counterplay: Leave them alive. They die with the Sire, and thinning them out only drags the phase out.

mechanics.name: Apocalypse
mechanics.description: Low on health, the Sire drags you beside it and detonates the arena two ticks later.
mechanics.counterplay: Run directly away the moment it moves you. The blast hits for most of your health.

_note: IDs are taken from RuneLite's gameval NpcID/AnimationID constants, so the numbers themselves are authoritative cache values. What still needs one live fight to confirm is the mapping: that each listed animation is the one the Sire actually plays for that mechanic, and that every trigger fires. See issue #9.
